stories.title: Points Redemption at Online Checkout
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to redeem my points for a discount during online checkout, so that I can use my earned rewards to save money
acceptance_criteria: Given I am at checkout with items in my cart, When I select 'Use points' and enter the number of points to redeem, Then the system calculates the discount (points × redemption_rate, default 100 points = £5) and displays '{points} points = £{discount} off'

Given I confirm the redemption, When the transaction processes, Then points are atomically deducted from my balance and a ledger entry is created with {type: 'redeem', points: -N, order_id, channel: 'online'}
Given the discount exceeds my order total, When I attempt to redeem, Then the system caps the discount at the order total and adjusts points used accordingly
Given the redemption screen, When navigated via screen reader, Then the points input, discount preview, and confirmation button are all properly labelled and announced

requirements_used: FR-02 — Points Redemption at Checkout — configurable rate, partial redemption, applied to order total
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §3.2 (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL for transactional data — ACID)

stories.reasoning: 5 points: redemption logic + atomic deduction + discount calculation + cap logic + UI. Accessibility AC for user-facing checkout screen.

stories.title: Points Redemption at POS
stories.user_story: As Sana, a store associate, I want to process a points redemption at the POS after the customer confirms, so that in-store customers can use their loyalty rewards
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer is identified at POS, When I initiate a redemption with their verbal confirmation, Then the API processes POST /v1/points/redeem with {customer_id, points_to_redeem, order_id, order_total, channel: 'in-store'}
Given the redemption succeeds, When the response is returned, Then it includes {success: true, discount_applied, remaining_balance, transaction_id} within 2 seconds
Given the customer has insufficient points, When I attempt the redemption, Then the API returns an error with their available balance and maximum redeemable amount

requirements_used: FR-02 — Points Redemption at Checkout — partial redemption, applied to order total

stories.reasoning: 3 points: reuses redemption engine from US-044 via API, POS-specific flow. Staff-initiated with verbal confirmation for in-store channel.

stories.title: Redemption Preset Amounts
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want to choose from preset redemption amounts, so that I can quickly redeem without calculating exact points
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the redemption screen, When it loads, Then I see preset options (100, 250, 500, 'Use all') alongside a custom input field
Given I select a preset, When chosen, Then the discount preview updates immediately showing the equivalent monetary value
Given I select 'Use all', When my balance is 347 points, Then it pre-fills 347 and shows the corresponding discount

requirements_used: FR-02 — Points Redemption at Checkout — partial redemption

stories.reasoning: 2 points: UI presets + dynamic calculation. Reduces friction for common redemption amounts.

stories.title: Over-Redemption Prevention
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want the system to prevent me from redeeming more points than I have, so that my balance never goes negative from redemptions
acceptance_criteria: Given my available balance is 200 points, When I attempt to redeem 300 points, Then the system rejects with: 'You have 200 points available. Maximum you can redeem: 200 points (£10).'
Given two redemption requests arrive simultaneously for the same customer, When processed concurrently, Then database row-level locking ensures only one succeeds if combined amount exceeds balance
Given the over-redemption check, When the balance is verified, Then it uses the real-time database value (not cached) to prevent race conditions

requirements_used: FR-06 — Over-Redemption Prevention — block if exceeds balance, show error
NFR-08 — Data Consistency

stories.reasoning: 5 points: row-level locking + concurrent request handling + real-time balance check. Critical financial integrity — prevents double-spend.

stories.title: Redemption Rules Engine — Minimum and Maximum Limits
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want clear feedback when my redemption doesn't meet the minimum threshold or exceeds the maximum discount, so that I understand the program rules
acceptance_criteria: Given the minimum redemption threshold is 100 points, When I attempt to redeem 50 points, Then the system rejects with: 'Minimum redemption is 100 points. You selected 50.'

Given the maximum discount is 50% of order total, When I attempt to redeem points exceeding that cap, Then the system rejects with: 'Maximum discount is 50% of order total (£{max_amount}). Please reduce points.'
Given all redemption rules are configurable, When a rule value is changed via admin, Then it takes effect on the Dunelm redemption attempt without code deployment

requirements_used: FR-21 — Redemption Rules Engine — min threshold, max per transaction, max discount percentage

stories.reasoning: 3 points: three validation rules + configurable values + clear error messages. Separated from over-redemption because these are business rules vs. balance integrity.

stories.title: Redemption Validation — Negative Path Scenarios
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want the system to handle edge cases gracefully during redemption, so that I'm never charged incorrectly
acceptance_criteria: Given my account is in 'suspended' or 'inactive' state, When I attempt to redeem, Then the system rejects with 'Your account is not eligible for redemption. Please contact support.'
Given a redemption request with points_to_redeem = 0, When submitted, Then it is rejected with 'Please enter a valid number of points to redeem'

Given the redemption service is experiencing high latency, When a request times out after 5 seconds, Then the customer sees 'Unable to process redemption right now. Please try again.' and no points are deducted

requirements_used: FR-06 — Over-Redemption Prevention
FR-21 — Redemption Rules Engine

stories.reasoning: 3 points: negative path story covering edge cases — inactive accounts, zero input, timeouts. Ensures no silent failures or incorrect deductions.

stories.title: Redemption Notification
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to receive a notification when I redeem points, so that I have confirmation of my redemption and know my remaining balance
acceptance_criteria: Given a 'points.redeemed' event is emitted, When the notification service processes it, Then a push notification is delivered within 30 seconds: 'You redeemed {points} points for £{discount} off your purchase! Remaining balance: {balance} points.'
Given the notification is sent, When it is delivered, Then it is also stored in the in-app notification center
Given I have disabled transactional notifications, When points are redeemed, Then no push is sent but the notification is stored in-app
Given the notification contains my balance, When transmitted, Then it is encrypted in transit and balance values are not logged in plain text

requirements_used: FR-07a — Points Redemption Notification — points redeemed, discount applied, remaining balance

stories.reasoning: 3 points: event consumption + notification delivery + preference check + in-app storage. Security AC for Confidential data.

stories.title: Customer Profile View
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to view my profile showing my personal details and loyalty status, so that I can see my membership information at a glance
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I navigate to my profile, Then I see: my name, email (with verified badge), phone (with verified badge), member since date, loyalty tier with badge, and lifetime points earned
Given my profile screen, When navigated via screen reader, Then all fields are announced with their labels and values, and verified badges are announced as 'verified'
Given the profile API, When a request is made with an expired or invalid token, Then it returns 401 Unauthorized and no profile data is exposed

requirements_used: FR-17 — Customer Profile Management — view/edit profile, view tier and membership date

stories.reasoning: 3 points: profile screen + data display + verified badges. Accessibility AC for user-facing. Security AC for auth check.

stories.title: Customer Profile Edit with Re-verification
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want to update my name, email, or phone number, so that my profile stays current
acceptance_criteria: Given I edit my name, When I save, Then the change is applied immediately without re-verification
Given I change my email address, When I submit the new email, Then an OTP is sent to the new email and the change only applies after successful OTP verification
Given I change my phone number, When I submit the new phone, Then an OTP is sent to the new phone and the change only applies after successful OTP verification
Given I enter an email already associated with another account, When I submit, Then it is rejected with 'This email is already in use by another account'

requirements_used: FR-17 — Customer Profile Management — view/edit profile

stories.reasoning: 5 points: edit form + OTP re-verification for email/phone + duplicate check. Re-verification prevents account takeover via email/phone change.

stories.title: Account Deletion (Right to Erasure)
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to delete my account, so that my personal data is removed in compliance with my privacy rights
acceptance_criteria: Given I tap 'Delete my account', When the confirmation modal appears, Then it clearly states the consequences: 'This will permanently remove your personal data and forfeit {balance} points. This cannot be undone.'
Given I confirm deletion, When processed, Then my PII is anonymized (name → 'Deleted User', email → hashed, phone → null) but ledger entries are retained for audit with anonymized customer reference
Given my account is deleted, When I attempt to log in with my old credentials, Then I receive 'Account not found' with an option to register a new account
stories.regulatory_linkage: UK GDPR Article 17 — Right to Erasure

requirements_used: FR-17 — Customer Profile Management

stories.reasoning: 3 points: confirmation flow + soft-delete with anonymization + login prevention. Regulatory requirement — GDPR right to erasure. Ledger retained for financial audit.

stories.title: Loyalty Dashboard — Points Balance Card & Tier Progress
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want my home screen to show my points balance and progress toward the Dunelm tier, so that I'm motivated to keep earning
acceptance_criteria: Given I am logged in, When I view the home screen, Then I see a points balance card showing: current points (large), monetary equivalent, and my tier badge
Given I have a tier above me, When the dashboard loads, Then I see a progress bar showing 'X more points to {Dunelm_tier}' with visual fill indicating progress percentage
Given I am on the highest tier, When the dashboard loads, Then the progress section shows 'You've reached our highest tier!' instead of a progress bar
Given the dashboard, When navigated via screen reader, Then the balance, tier, and progress are announced in a logical reading order

requirements_used: FR-19 — Loyalty Dashboard — balance, tier, progress, recent transactions, active promotions
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §9 Frontend (React SPA, shared design system)

stories.reasoning: 5 points: balance card + tier badge + progress bar + edge case (max tier) + responsive layout. Primary engagement surface. Accessibility AC for user-facing.

stories.title: Loyalty Dashboard — Recent Transactions & Quick Actions
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want to see my recent transactions and quick action buttons on the dashboard, so that I can quickly access key features
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the home screen, When it loads, Then I see the last 5 transactions with date, type icon, and points amount, with a 'View all' link to full history
Given the dashboard, When I see quick action buttons, Then 'View QR Code', 'Transaction History', and 'Redeem Points' are displayed as tappable cards
Given a section is still loading, When the dashboard renders, Then that section shows a skeleton loading state independently of other sections

requirements_used: FR-19 — Loyalty Dashboard — recent transactions, active promotions

stories.reasoning: 3 points: recent transactions widget + quick actions + independent skeleton loading. Separated from balance card to keep stories focused.

stories.title: Dashboard Pull-to-Refresh
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer on mobile, I want to pull down to refresh my dashboard, so that I can see the latest data on demand
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the mobile dashboard, When I pull down, Then all sections refresh with a loading indicator and display updated data
Given the refresh fails due to network error, When it completes, Then I see a toast: 'Unable to refresh. Please check your connection.' and the previous data remains visible

requirements_used: FR-19 — Loyalty Dashboard
NFR-09 — Mobile App Performance

stories.reasoning: 2 points: pull-to-refresh gesture + error handling. Standard mobile UX pattern for data freshness.

stories.title: Staff Customer Search
stories.user_story: As Sana, a store associate, I want to search for customers by phone, email, name, or loyalty ID, so that I can look up their loyalty information to assist them
acceptance_criteria: Given I am authenticated with 'loyalty_staff' role, When I search by phone number (exact match), Then matching customers are returned with name, tier, points balance, and member since
Given I search by name, When I enter a partial name, Then fuzzy matching returns relevant results ranked by relevance
Given search results are displayed, When I view them, Then email and phone are partially masked (e.g., j***@email.com) to minimize PII exposure
Given I am not authenticated with a staff role, When I attempt to access the staff search API, Then I receive 403 Forbidden

requirements_used: FR-20 — Staff Customer Lookup — search by phone, email, name, loyalty ID from POS

stories.reasoning: 5 points: multi-field search + fuzzy matching + PII masking + RBAC authorization. Security AC for role-based access control.

stories.title: Staff Customer Search — Rate Limiting & Negative Paths
stories.user_story: As a platform engineer, I want staff search to be rate-limited and handle edge cases, so that the system is protected from abuse and enumeration attacks
acceptance_criteria: Given a staff user makes more than 60 searches per minute, When the Dunelm search is attempted, Then it receives 429 Too Many Requests with Retry-After header
Given a search query returns no results, When displayed, Then the staff sees 'No customers found matching your search' with suggestion to check spelling or try a different field
Given a search query is empty or less than 2 characters, When submitted, Then it is rejected with 'Please enter at least 2 characters to search'

requirements_used: FR-20 — Staff Customer Lookup
NFR-07 — API Rate Limiting and Abuse Prevention

stories.reasoning: 2 points: rate limiting + input validation + empty state. Negative path story to cover abuse prevention and edge cases.

stories.title: Notification Preferences — Toggle Controls
stories.user_story: As Clara, a loyalty customer, I want to control which notifications I receive, so that I only get messages I find useful
acceptance_criteria: Given I navigate to notification preferences, When the screen loads, Then I see toggle switches for: Transactional (default ON), Promotional (default OFF), and System (default ON)
Given I toggle a preference, When I change it, Then the change is saved immediately and a confirmation toast appears: 'Preferences updated'
Given the Transactional toggle, When I attempt to disable it, Then it remains on with a tooltip: 'Transaction notifications cannot be fully disabled — they keep you informed about balance changes'
Given the preferences screen, When navigated via screen reader, Then each toggle is announced with its category name, description, and current state (on/off)
stories.regulatory_linkage: UK GDPR — consent for marketing communications

requirements_used: FR-30 — Notification Preferences Management — opt in/out by category, transactional on by default, promotional requires opt-in
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §5.2 (UK GDPR — consent for marketing communications)

stories.reasoning: 3 points: toggle UI + immediate save + transactional lock + toast feedback. Promotional opt-in required by GDPR. Accessibility AC for user-facing.

stories.title: Email Notification Preference
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want to opt in to receiving email copies of my notifications, so that I have a record in my inbox
acceptance_criteria: Given I am on the notification preferences screen, When I see the email preference toggle (default OFF), Then I can enable it to receive email copies of notifications
Given I enable email notifications, When a push notification is triggered, Then an email copy is also sent to my registered email address

requirements_used: FR-30 — Notification Preferences Management

stories.reasoning: 2 points: toggle + email delivery integration. Simple extension of preference system.

stories.title: Notification Preferences API
stories.user_story: As a backend developer, I want a preferences API that stores and retrieves customer notification settings, so that all notification services respect customer choices
acceptance_criteria: Given a GET request to /v1/customers/{id}/preferences, When called with valid auth, Then it returns the current preference state for all categories
Given a PUT request with updated preferences, When processed, Then the preferences are persisted and subsequent notification deliveries respect the new settings
Given a request to update another customer's preferences, When the authenticated customer_id doesn't match, Then it returns 403 Forbidden

requirements_used: FR-30 — Notification Preferences Management

stories.reasoning: 2 points: CRUD API + authorization check. Security AC ensures customers can only modify their own preferences.

stories.title: Redemption Failure Handling
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a loyalty customer, I want clear feedback when a redemption fails, so that I know my points are safe and can try again
acceptance_criteria: Given the redemption service is unavailable, When I attempt to redeem, Then I see 'Unable to process your redemption right now. Your points are safe — please try again in a few minutes.' and no points are deducted
Given a redemption request times out, When the system detects the timeout, Then it verifies no deduction occurred before showing the error (no phantom deductions)
Given a network error during redemption on mobile, When the request fails, Then the app shows an error state with a 'Retry' button

requirements_used: FR-02 — Points Redemption at Checkout
NFR-08 — Data Consistency

stories.reasoning: 3 points: negative path story covering service unavailability, timeouts, and network errors. Critical that no phantom deductions occur on failure.

stories.title: Dashboard — Empty State for New Members
stories.user_story: As Nathan, a newly registered loyalty customer, I want a welcoming dashboard even before I've made any purchases, so that I understand what to do Dunelm
acceptance_criteria: Given I am a new member with 0 points and no transactions, When I view the dashboard, Then I see a welcome message: 'Welcome to Dunelm Rewards! Make your first purchase to start earning points.' with a visual guide
Given the empty dashboard, When the recent transactions section loads, Then it shows 'No transactions yet' with a prompt to shop

requirements_used: FR-19 — Loyalty Dashboard

stories.reasoning: 2 points: empty state UI + onboarding guidance. Important for new member experience — first impression drives engagement.

stories.title: Staff Customer Lookup — Full Loyalty Summary
stories.user_story: As Sana, a store associate, I want to view a customer's full loyalty summary after selecting them from search results, so that I can provide personalized service
acceptance_criteria: Given I select a customer from search results, When the detail view loads, Then I see: full name, tier with badge, points balance, monetary equivalent, member since date, and last 3 transactions
Given the customer detail view, When loaded, Then it completes within 2 seconds
Given the detail view contains customer data, When accessed, Then all access is logged to the audit trail with my staff_id and the customer_id viewed

requirements_used: FR-20 — Staff Customer Lookup

stories.reasoning: 3 points: detail view + performance SLA + audit logging. Audit trail ensures staff access to customer data is tracked for compliance.

regression_summary.recommendation: Greenfield — no regression testing needed. All stories are new capabilities.
